feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 28 May 2026 7:48am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 28 May 2026 at 7:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry and bright with sunny spells but becoming cloudier mid to late afternoon, and with the risk of mist/fog patches along some coasts particularly in the south by this evening. Top temperature around 20°C, fresh southeast winds gradually veering southerly and decreasing for a while this afternoon.


##Outlook##

Dry tomorrow with spells of sunshine and moderate to fresh southwesterly winds. Top temperature 19°C.

Saturday will start dry and bright but soon turning cloudy ahead of a spell of rain arriving early afternoon, before clearing away later in the day. Light to moderate south or southwesterly winds will gradually increase through the day to become fresh to strong later. Top temperatures 16°C.
